name: art-institute-chicago-mcp-server
description: Search the Art Institute of Chicago collection: artworks, artists, exhibitions, and audio guides.

AIC_CONTACT.title: Contact for the Art Institute API
AIC_CONTACT.description: Optional. An email or URL the museum can reach, in printable ASCII, sent in the AIC-User-Agent header. Defaults to the repository URL.

AIC_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE.title: Requests per minute
AIC_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE.description: Optional. Outbound request budget for api.artic.edu (1-600). Defaults to 50, under the published 60 per minute anonymous limit.
